retained_failures.name: initial source media journey
retained_failures.finding: The five-second provider-observation fixture expired before a provider call. The driver retained intent and no final result; its process was cleaned up by the owned fixture. The corrected fixture grants up to 45 seconds for external SDK startup/control before provider observation. SDK deadlines remain unchanged; the underlying initial startup latency cause is not assigned.

retained_failures.name: source driver remote hangup
retained_failures.finding: The fixture ended its call after returning 19 media frames. The driver was not in expected-remote-end mode, and receiver shutdown also caused a redundant sender TimeoutError. Explicit expected-hangup and continuous fixtures now have separate passing journeys. Sender cancellation no longer creates a second failure when the receiver already recorded the result; unexpected media errors still fail.

retained_failures.name: recording-write failure unit fixture
retained_failures.finding: The test root used macOS /var while the driver resolved /private/var, so output admission rejected it before the intended failure injection. Resolve the temporary test root; the production path restriction is unchanged. The final check injects recording failure and verifies SessionEnd, retained context and a failed result.

behavior: An independent Python process uses the public SDK and an existing protected task Session, performs no replacement invite, receives native QUIC PCMU, and ends that Session without completing/cancelling its task or losing sourced context.

An independent real MCP client recalls the seeded fact using the prepared provider mapping before the fixture releases the audio connection. This verifies tool wiring, not model speech or instruction following.
Separate normal and expected remote-hangup cases retain scoped context and clean up all owned child processes.
Ordinary non-task mode still invites, accepts, captures audio and ends its own Session.

Configuration admission, current task/session matching, uncertain controls, stable intent publication, malformed/oversized scenarios, installed asset tampering and failed recording writes have explicit checks.
A recording write failure cannot skip session teardown. Received audio/time budgets are enforced; capture alone is not semantic speech acceptance.
